NAME

backtrace_text_t - Capture current stack into bt.

SYNOPSIS

#include <include/ascii-chat/debug/backtrace.h>

Data Fields


char colored [16384]
char plain [16384]

Detailed Description

Capture current stack into bt.

Calls platform_backtrace() to capture raw return addresses. Does not symbolize (symbols remain NULL).

Parameters

bt Backtrace structure to fill (must not be NULL) Shared semantic formatting for terminal logs and TUI backtraces. No output or ownership transfer.
